meta.author: ATLAS
meta.purpose: Ranked build list of city and neighborhood pages to add next (competitor gap 8, local search depth). Plan and data only; no pages built.
meta.pattern: /mobile-service/{city}-fl (cityPath in src/data/cityPages.js); title is '<seoTitle> | TireDrop' (<=60); meta description <=155

statusMeaning.READY: Page v1 can ship using only sourced facts (population snippet agreed twice, county, ZIP rule, shop facts), with no ZIP chips or roads, as Tamarac did. Forge still adds depth from government sources.
statusMeaning.NEEDS-FACT: A named fact gap (see needsFact) must close first.

meta.scoring: score = populationPoints (>=150k:5, 100-149k:4, 70-99k:3, 40-69k:2, <40k:1) x proximityPoints (ring 1:5 .. ring 5:1). Ties broken by population. No search-volume data was available.
caveats: Every population is a search-result snippet, not a page read: census.gov, broward.org, edr.state.fl.us, pbcgov.org and Wikipedia were all blocked by the network proxy.
Proximity ring is an analyst estimate carried over from the earlier unverified local-SEO research; distance and drive time fields are null on purpose.
Candidate ZIPs are from general knowledge and are UNVERIFIED; all were run through isInServiceArea() and every one is covered.

2020 Census population 66,846: census.gov QuickFacts search snippet, agreed by a second search (SNIPPET-ONLY, not read as a page). Round it or cite it as the 2020 Census.
Coverage is decided by the ZIP where the car is parked, not by the city name on the address (serviceArea.js, isInServiceArea).
The Sunrise shop is at 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd, Sunrise, FL 33351, phone (954) 773-1896, open Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM and Saturday 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM (src/data/business.js).
Tires ship free to the Sunrise shop (ship-to-store); the shop fits them in a bay (business.js, existing city page FAQ wording).
Highway and expressway shoulders are not worked: call 911 or *347 (FDOT Road Rangers) first (existing HIGHWAY_LINE in cityPages.js).

ZIP list: verify against USPS before listing ZIPs on the page; until then ship the page with no ZIP chips, as Tamarac did, and let the ZIP checker decide.
